user_story: As a user, I want to view the API endpoint documentation list on the Automation Exercise website so that I can understand the available APIs for testing. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The page title should be 'Automation Practice for API Testing'. 2. The page should display the heading 'APIs List for practice'. 3. The page should include a subscription input field with the placeholder 'Your email address'. 4. The page should have a button with the ID 'subscribe' that allows users to subscribe. 5. The page should display links to various API endpoints, such as 'API 1: Get All Products List'.
